name: Drawer
description: A full-height side panel that slides in from the left edge over a scrim, for a phone menu or navigation. A modal dialog with BottomSheet's feel: the same scrim, focus handling, Escape and motion recipes, turned on its side.
usage: Controlled: `open` and `onClose`; it calls onClose on a scrim tap, Escape or a swipe left, and the caller sets open to false
`label` is required: there is no head to name the dialog
The children are the whole contents (a logo, links, a theme switch, a version line); they scroll inside the drawer. Put a close button among them if you want one
It is a drawer at every width: the caller decides when to show one (useIsPhone is exported for that)
design: Full height, min(20rem, 85vw) wide, on the elevated surface with elevation-3 (or the darker canvas surface with surface="canvas", the same shadow plus a 1 px right border, border-subtle light and border-default dark: on canvas in dark mode the panel is as dark as the dimmed page and the shadow alone loses the edge); the far (right) corners rounded --radius-2xl, the near ones square against the edge, as the bottom sheet's

It runs the screen's full height: the overlay is fixed inset-0 and at least 100lvh, so where iOS sizes a fixed box to a shorter viewport (Safari's toolbar, a standalone app after the keyboard) the scrim and panel still reach the bottom edge, behind the home bar

Its contents stay inside the visible viewport: the scrolling body is capped at 100dvh (as BottomSheet's cap), so with a browser toolbar out (Safari's, Chrome Android's URL bar; the scroll lock keeps it out) a mt-auto footer still sits above the toolbar, while the background runs lvh tall behind it
Its contents sit inside the safe-area insets: pt-safe-md, pb-safe-md, pl-safe-md, and pr-md, gap sm between children
Slides in on recipe.sheetIn and out on recipe.sheetOut; the scrim fades on fadeIn and contentOut, as BottomSheet's

A swipe left on the panel past a quarter of its width, or a left flick (500 px/s), closes it; a shorter swipe springs back on sheetIn. A swipe never starts on a link, button or other control (pressing one and moving stays a click). The panel's touch-action is pan-y pinch-zoom: vertical scrolling and pinch-zoom stay the browser's, so a horizontally scrolling child inside won't pan by touch
The page under it doesn't scroll while it's open (body overflow hidden, padded for the scrollbar it removes); one lock shared by every open drawer, released when the last one closes
Portalled to <body>: the theme's look classes must be on <body> too
accessibility: Focus moves into the drawer on open, Tab and Shift+Tab wrap inside it, and focus returns to the opener on close (useDialogFocus, shared with Modal and BottomSheet)
Escape closes only the top dialog, and not when a widget inside claimed it (preventDefault)
Under Reduce Motion it appears and goes at once: no slide, no fade

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on a scrim tap, Escape or a swipe left

props.name: side
props.description: The edge it slides from; only the left for now

props.name: surface
props.description: Its background: the elevated surface, or the darker canvas surface (--color-surface-canvas) with a hairline on its open edge

props.name: children
props.description: The contents; they scroll inside the drawer
